# Font Awesome 6 Free

Vendored `Font Awesome 6 Free-Solid-900.otf` from Font Awesome Free 6.7.2. The
app draws its button glyphs from this font; it is copied into the user font
directory on first run so the font server can use it.

Source: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome/releases/tag/6.7.2
